questions.q: A tangent to a circle meets the circle at ____.
questions.explanation: That is the definition of a tangent.

questions.q: The tangent at a point of a circle is ____ to the radius through that point.
questions.explanation: The tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of contact.

questions.q: Tangents drawn from an external point to a circle are ____.
questions.explanation: The two tangent segments are equal.

questions.q: A point is 13 cm from the centre of a circle of radius 5 cm. What is the length of the tangent from it?
How many tangents can be drawn from a point inside a circle?
questions.explanation: Every line through an interior point cuts the circle.
